facts.text: Ladies, more singing after supper, and a lot less mumbling over the peas.
facts.why: Not a line from the film, and printed in quote marks. Deloris does tell Sister Alma to check her battery when rehearsing, so the note works in her voice.
facts.fix: Ladies, more singing after supper and a lot less mumbling. Sister Alma, check your battery.
